title: Duplicate host labels can change explicit mailbox alias recipient when a peer disconnects
outcome: An explicit host-label mailbox alias cannot silently select a different host when another enrolled host with the same label becomes unavailable; UUID targets remain exact.
acceptance: A host label associated with more than one distinct retained host id refuses with UUID guidance before and after either peer disconnects.
The same parser/selector is reused; current native host-UUID targets and append authority fences retain their behavior.
